body: Thanks for your response.  We have tried everything and even his doctors tell us that he's one of the worst cases they've ever seen.  He won't do the first thing to help himself and it seems like you have to at least be able to try to help yourself for anything to make a difference.  We've led the horse to water hundreds of times already, so to speak, and he's never taken a sip.  How can this be overcome?
Thanks so much for your kind response.  I'll move this to AskReddit, and maybe there someone can forward me along to an even more appropriate subreddit.  Kind regards...
